text:
maria: Kickoff quick: mode-led hero experiment for Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages. Outcome: tightened hero messaging, short benchmark blurbs, gated latency playbook on webinar reg, and lead routing rules. timeline = 10 business days?
aj: Good. propose blog + social 72h before webinar. webinar Wed 10am PT.
noah: I'll do three hero lockups in Figma (engineering, ROI, and human stories) and export desktop/mobile frames by Thu.
sam: I'll produce tight benchmark blurbs (one sentence each) and a single comparison stat we can show in the hero: e.g., "p95 latency delta: X ms". Also draft the gated PDF.
tess: I'll stand up the webinar landing + HubSpot form. Confirm mapping: mode hidden field -> tag pipeline: hosted->inbound-sdr, dedicated->ae-dedicated, private->ae-private+se.
maria: Correct. Also ensure links include utm_campaign=mode_launch_q2 and utm_content=hero_variant. Gate asset as latency-playbook.pdf and include short form field for "primary use-case" (dropdown).
aj: Hero microcopy candidates (concise):
  Hosted: "Hosted API — fast time-to-value, predictable unit cost."
  Dedicated: "Dedicated capacity — reserved GPUs, steady SLAs."
  Private: "Private deployment — VPC, KMS, enterprise controls."
noah: Alternate, more empathy-led:
  Hosted: "Build quickly. Pay as you grow."
  Dedicated: "Commit to performance. Get consistent latency."
  Private: "Control your data. Keep inference in your network."
sam: Benchmark blurbs (draft):
  Hosted: "Great for experimentation — low-start cost, elastic scaling; median latency suited for interactive workloads."
  Dedicated: "Designed for predictable production throughput with tight p95 bounds under steady load."
  Private: "For regulated workloads: audit logs, KMS, and on-prem option with compatibility testing."
tess: Registration form snippet: ```html
<form>
  <input type="hidden" name="mode" value="${MODE}">
  <select name="use_case">
    <option>Search</option><option>Chat</option><option>Summarization</option>
  </select>
</form>
```
HubSpot routing pseudo: ```js
const tag = mode === 'hosted' ? 'inbound_sdr' : mode === 'dedicated' ? 'ae_dedicated' : 'ae_private_se';
createHubSpotContact(contact, { tags: [tag, utm_campaign] });
```
maria: Default landing hero when mode missing = Hosted. Also set experiment key `mode_hero_test_v1` in GA. We'll A/B two CTA families for 14 days.
aj: CTA families:
  Family 1: "Get started — Hosted" / "Reserve capacity — Dedicated" / "Request private demo"
  Family 2: "Try hosted API" / "Talk to sales — Dedicated" / "Book private deployment consult"
noah: I'll include small metric pill under hero: e.g., "p95: 120ms (hosted); 90ms (dedicated)" — sam to confirm numbers.
sam: I'll validate numbers and publish CSV with measurement methodology. Will include note: test hardware x, sequence len y.
rachel: From eng: ensure demos use a quantized model variant for Dedicated vs Hosted comparison to keep results fair. I'll coordinate with infra.
ops-bot: Reminder: deploy window Thu 07:00 PT. Please put final assets in /releases/marketing by Wed 20:00 PT.
maria: Action list:
  - noah: Figma heroes + metric pill frames (due Thu 20:00 PT)
  - sam: benchmark blurbs + CSV + latency-playbook.pdf (due Wed 12:00 PT)
  - tess: webinar landing + form + HubSpot workflow (due Wed 18:00 PT)
  - aj: social + blog copy + scheduling (due Wed 18:00 PT)
  - rachel: infra / quantization parity check (due Tue EOD)
  - maria: dry-run + UTM mapping (Mon before publish)

maria: Quick alignment: webinar title candidate = "Live: Serving LLMs — Performance, Cost, and Deployments". 20-min demo + 10 Q&A. Speakers: Sam (PM), Rachel (Eng), Lewis (Solutions).
noah: Question: do we surface the p95 numbers in hero or keep vague and link to playbook?
aj: Test both. Variant A explicit numbers, Variant B qualitative line + CTA to playbook.
sam: I'll prepare both datasets. include confidence intervals in playbook.
tess: I'll add hidden utm_content to detect hero variant clicks.
maria: OK. Final sync Fri 10am PT. Thanks — let's keep copy lean and metric-forward. :rocket:
